data.narrative:
Shine Technologies, a Series E climate & energy company founded by Greg Piefer, has raised over $1.0B to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 companies in the Climate & Energy sector, comprising 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (0 same-stage peers, 2 adjacent-stage peers, 0 similar-tier peers; analysis requires ≥3 datapoints). Consequently, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement to the $1.0B raised baseline, yielding an implied valuation of $1.4B.

The triangulated range spans $1.2B to $1.6B, with a median of $1.4B. This narrow single-method result reflects the scarcity of direct peer comparables at Shine's stage and tier within Climate & Energy. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.4x multiplier for frontier-tech advancement and the absence of recent market-rate comparables in this capital-intensive sector. Additional comparable data or revenue/unit economics would strengthen conviction in this valuation.
